answer: The nebula cap is enforced at intake and mesa shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, since each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a tide tag. Slashing removes 68 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
